verification_report.summary: The whole supplied subsection is correct under the stated independent premises. Sequential checks establish the equivalence of the two strongly Gauduchon definitions, the Gauduchon and balanced implications, and the exact primitive dc Gamma = d[(i/(4pi))(beta−conjugate(beta))], including its sign, normalization, and reality. The positive-current obstruction follows from type decomposition, distributional Stokes, and strictly positive mass. The additive complex action is holomorphic, free, and proper; excluding zero vectors is essential to the norm arguments. The unique smooth unit-sphere normalization gives a diffeomorphism of the quotient with S3×S3, proving compactness and connectedness. Kunneth gives H1=H2=H5=0, hence V_X=K_X=W_X=0 and, using Gauduchon existence, LG(X)={0}. Projectivization descends to a surjective holomorphic submersion. Its pulled-back Fubini–Study form is closed, semipositive, and of rank two everywhere. It is nonzero and de Rham exact, so it excludes strongly Gauduchon and balanced metrics. Its Bott–Chern class is nonzero by the Gauduchon mass identity, pseudoeffective by its positive representative, and outside im(j_X) because H1=0. The attribution matches [Ornea–Verbitsky, Remarks 5.6–5.8 and Example 5.7](https://arxiv.org/html/2411.05595v2), checked through theorem search followed by primary-source and archived-text verification; the differing dc normalization causes no mismatch. The example uses neither general cone duality nor bimeromorphic invariance, and only the exact-current obstruction direction is asserted. No errors or gaps were found.
